newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian jailed for defiling Jewish cemetery.
newsitem.headline: Austrian jailed for defiling Jewish cemetery.

text.p: An Austrian court on Tuesday jailed a man for four years for desecrating a Jewish cemetery in 1992 and trying to revive National Socialism, state television reported.

The man, 25, named by state television as Wolfgang T. pleaded guilty to spraying swastikas -- emblems of Adolf Hitler's Nazis -- and slogans such as "foreigners out" on the gravestones of a Jewish cemetery in the southern town of Eisenstadt.
The defendant said he had acted under the influence of a man named as Christian A., who was a friend from school and is on the run from the police.
"I went along with it so as not to lose my only friend," he said, adding his actions had been "a gross stupidity".
T. had since given up his Nazi beliefs, his lawyer said.
Both men were members of the far right Freedom Party's youth group, allegedly recruited by Karl Schweitzer, former general secretary of the far right Freedom Party.
